params.caption: 🖥️ Nvidia promises pay raises and early equity to calm staff after Huang exit At Nvidia's first all-hands since Jensen Huang resigned, interim CEO Colette Kress reportedly offered employees higher wages and more equity on an accelerated schedule, before December. Staff were reportedly told "we're going to be fine" as the company tries to stop unrest and a feared talent exodus. 🕒 Nov 18, 2026 · 21:40 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Tom's Hardware 👥 @nvidia 💬 Will raises be enough to keep Nvidia's talent?
